class.name: ThespeonImporter
class.description: Manages the modules installed in the addon's [code]res://addons/lingotion-thespeon/runtime-files/[/code] directory. Every method blocks, and none of them loads a model, so this class suits editor tools. A [Thespeon] node that already exists does not see the changes until [method Thespeon.refresh] is called. [b]Warning:[/b] Do not delete modules while any [Thespeon] node, in any process, has models loaded.

method.name: delete_all_models
method.description: Deletes every installed module. Returns the same [Dictionary] as [method preview_delete].

method.name: delete_model
method.description: Deletes one module, and every file no remaining module needs. The parameters select the module as in [method preview_delete]. Deleting a language module that a remaining character depends on fails unless [param force] is [code]true[/code]. Returns the same [Dictionary] as [method preview_delete].

method.name: import_pack
method.description: Imports the modules in the [code].lingotion[/code] pack at [param pack_path].

method.name: list_models
method.description: Returns the installed modules, in the same form as [method Thespeon.list_models]. Returns an empty [Dictionary], and prints an error, if the directory cannot be read.

method.name: preview_delete
method.description: Reports what [method delete_model] would do, without changing anything. If [param model] is empty, previews [method delete_all_models] instead. [param model] is a module identifier or a display name. [param module_type] applies only to characters. [param module_type] and [param module_version] are ignored when empty. Returns a [Dictionary] with the keys: - [code]status[/code]: an [enum Error] code. - [code]binaries_removed[/code]: the number of files that would be removed. - [code]bytes_freed[/code]: the disk space that would be freed. - [code]binaries_kept[/code]: the number of files kept because a remaining module still needs them. - [code]stranded_characters[/code]: the number of characters that would be left with no language module. [method delete_model] refuses to strand characters unless [code]force[/code] is set. - [code]problems[/code]: the number of module configs that could not be read. - [code]swept[/code]: [code]false[/code] if problems prevented removing files, in which case [code]binaries_removed[/code] and [code]bytes_freed[/code] are [code]0[/code].
